learnerStatement: Simulated learner. This review finds problems; it is not evidence that anyone learned.
learnerBoundary: Everyday numeracy, simple charts, comparison of numbers and familiar household objects; no domain-specific theory assumed.

observations.outcome: Right E (14), left remained F; reveal unlocked

observations.action: Turned all four left switches off

observations.outcome: Reconstructs original D6, first changes F6 and FE, and current 0000 1110 = 0E; explains 16 settings per four switches and exactly two symbols per byte

prediction.reason: Clear alternatives separate value error and reversed groups.

interaction.reason: Left and right changes isolate independent symbols; all-off boundary visibly zero.

payoff.reason: Explanation uses original, intermediate and current state to connect grouping to two symbols.

clarity.reason: Weighted on/off controls and decimal-to-symbol feedback legible on tested desktop.

transfer.reason: Four-bit grouping principle stated with byte condition; no separate applied case.

surprise.reason: Correct prediction confirmed; independent group response adds supporting insight.

visualExplanation.reason: Two spatial groups and weighted switches directly carry conversion.

playfulness.reason: Reversible toggles allow inspecting independence and zero boundary.

practicalValue.reason: Concrete binary-to-hex reading skill for bytes.

depth.reason: Independent grouping and zero/F boundaries illustrate one representation mapping.

complexity.reason: Links weighted binary addition, groups of four and unfamiliar A-F symbols.
complexity.conceptualDemand: balanced: supported representation changes and addition
complexity.interfaceBurden: low: eight labelled toggles and immediate sums

whyCool: Flipping the left worth-2 switch changes D6 to F6 while the right symbol stays fixed, making the two-symbol grouping visible.
caveat: Hex notation is novel for the declared boundary; no independent application task follows the mapping.
missingEvidence: Phone, keyboard-only, focus, contrast measurement, zoom/reflow and reduced motion untested
